The reading order is materially broken by the way links are extracted. In the source document, hyperlinks are embedded inline within paragraphs. The output extracts the plain text of the link into paragraphs, but then dumps the actual `link` objects at the very end of the page content arrays, often after the page footer. This disjointed placement of links out of their original sentence flow breaks the logical reading order.
